backbone._note: EfficientAT mn30_as (Schmid et al., ICASSP 2023): MobileNetV3 width 3.0, ~39M params, AudioSet mAP 48.2, trained at 32 kHz / 128 mel - our 16 kHz clips are resampled, so its mel bins above 8 kHz stay empty. Tokens = the 4 x 13 cells of the 2880-channel last feature map.

pooled_stats._note: Per-clip mean / std of the 2880-d pooled vector of the pretrained network, averaged over 256 train mixtures (every 120th train row; molab 2026-10-06); across clips they vary by +-0.0012 / +-0.0009. Folded into the head's first Linear so FiLM's LayerNorm does not blow up the pretrained logits (see models/efficientat_backbone.py).

teacher_backbone._note: Same checkpoint as the mid project (sha256 e5815275...). dropout/layerdrop override the checkpoint cfg (0.0/0.05) with the BEATs paper's fine-tuning values.
teacher_backbone._teacher_note: The teacher stays BEATs on clean noise: the checkpoint is read from outputs.teacher_dir, trained by train_config_beats_fullsnr.json (teacher36).

teacher._recipe_note: BEATs paper (Chen et al., ICML 2023) appendix Table 4, AS-20K column - closest in size to our 30k clips: SpecAugment 0.2, peak lr 1e-4, cosine, warmup 8K/80K = 10%, layer-wise lr decay 0.3, dropout 0.1, layer dropout 0.1, weight decay 0.01. Deviation: no mixup (0.8 in the paper) - not implemented, and it does not compose cleanly with per-clip KD/CRD targets.

attention._note: Soft attention mask A(t,f) over the patch tokens (direction 2, run7_attn). hidden=128 matches FiLM and the CRD projection; lr matches film_lr, the rate every other new module here uses. Neither value comes from a paper for this task.

student._recipe_note: BEATs paper (Chen et al., ICML 2023) appendix Table 4, AS-20K column - closest in size to our 30k clips: SpecAugment 0.2, peak lr 1e-4, cosine, warmup 8K/80K = 10%, layer-wise lr decay 0.3, dropout 0.1, layer dropout 0.1, weight decay 0.01. Deviation: no mixup (0.8 in the paper) - not implemented, and it does not compose cleanly with per-clip KD/CRD targets.

augment._note: No roll for the student: patch-level CRD pairs student patch i with teacher patch i, and a time shift on the mixture only would misalign them.

student._backbone_recipe_note: EfficientAT's own downstream fine-tuning: one lr, no layer-wise decay - FSD50K (~40k clips, closest to our 30k) uses lr 4e-5 at batch 32, our effective batch (README, ex_fsd50k.py). BEATs' decay 0.3 over 17 conv stages would leave the lower ones at lr ~1e-13, i.e. frozen. Everything else as the BEATs recipe.

loss._note: crd_level 'patch' aligns every patch token against the teacher's; 'pooled' reproduces the BEATs project's single-vector CRD. patch is the reason for switching backbones - see VERSIONS.md. Weights r/a/b come from the CRD reference repo (-r 1 -a 1 -b 0.8); do not invent replacements.

gates._teacher_gate_note: Gate = baseline_band_accuracy + 0.10 = 0.6315. The mid project's absolute 0.75 floor sat above a 0.67 mixture baseline; carried to this band (baseline 0.53) it stopped a clean-noise teacher of 0.738, which is 0.21 above the baseline - twice the mid project's teacher headroom (0.78 - 0.67 = 0.11). Flagged as uncalibrated for SSLAM/high from the first commit; recalibrated after the teacher sweep of 2026-09-28.
gates._baseline_band_note: Published BEATs-Mixture, Result.xlsx 'Theo tung SNR': (0.5769@15dB + 0.4861@20dB)/2 and (0.5757+0.4830)/2, equal support (1080 each). This is the gate; it is NOT the same run as BEATs_Experts/checkpoint/test_metrics_36.json (that checkpoint's own 15/20 numbers are 0.6102/0.5315 - a different training run, no per-clip predictions, cannot enter a paired test).

published_baseline.name: BEATs-Mixture (Result.xlsx)
published_baseline._note: Copied from Result.xlsx, sheet 'Theo tung SNR', rows BEATs-Mixture / final, all six levels (the band-only report keeps 15 and 20; --full-test uses all). Only accuracy and F1 exist there, and no per-clip predictions, so it cannot enter the McNemar comparison.

evaluation._note: Same protocol as train_config_beats_fullsnr.json - train, validate (select_on full) and test on all six SNR levels, same teacher, same KD/CRD/FiLM/attention settings, same epochs, batch, schedule and seed - only the student backbone (and its fine-tuning lr where noted) changes. Patch-level CRD pools the teacher's 24 x 8 token grid onto the student's own grid (expert_lib.align_patch_grid).
